_comment: Audit finding D (2026-09-14): guard-figma-code.sh's Block 3 can be bypassed by cloning the SAME small component N times to inflate the instance count past N unnamed/unrecognized hand-drawn FRAME siblings — confirmed exploitable at the code-text level (see guard-figma-code.sh's own comment on Block 3). This fixture proves the safety net: verify-invariants.js inspects the REAL built tree, not code call counts, so the unrecognized-name frames still fail INV 1 regardless of how many real clones happened elsewhere. Expected: exit 2, FAIL_FAKE_COMPONENT on both Custom Widget frames — proves the bypass never reaches a shipped screen even though the pre-build code gate misses it.
